.subckt DUT VIN VOUT VSS VREF
* Matched dividers compare VREF/2 with approximately VOUT/4
RREFTOP VREF RP 500k
RREFBOT RP VSS 500k
RFBTOP VOUT FB 1.503meg
RFBBOT FB VSS 500k
RBLEED VOUT VSS 33k
* Shared PMOS current reference and mirrored bias devices
XPBIAS PB PB VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=5 l=0.15
RBIAS PB VSS 30k
XPTAIL TAIL PB VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.15
XPPULL G PB VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3.6 l=0.15
* PMOS input pair with NMOS mirror load
XPREF MIR RP TAIL VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=38 l=0.19
XPFB X FB TAIL VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=38 l=0.19
XNBIAS MIR MIR VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5
XNMIR X MIR VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5
* Common-source gate driver and large low-dropout PMOS pass device
XNDRV G X VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5
XPASS VOUT G VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.15 m=4
CFAS G VOUT 10p
CMIR VOUT MIR 1.15p
.ends DUT
